reason: Checked every use of ren_i in src/ (zero page &4D, ren_zp, renderer-private): reads are only render.6502 .shown's LDX ren_i after span_in_zone (the sole path through .shown_y; .shown/.shown_y referenced nowhere else), mark_to_draw and close_over_overlaps (each does STX ren_i before any read; list_live/list_recorded/widen_by_live are reached only from the latter), and tools only watch it. Non-shown exits (classified, near_screen/BRA listed) never read it and keep X. record_differs keeps X; BNE stale and DEBUG_FULLREDRAW's BRA stale use X directly, as before. TXA/ORA/TAY still follow so A,Y unchanged; STX affects no flags. Only difference: ren_i's final value after the loop is the last shown slot rather than slot 33, dead as mark_to_draw/gather rewrite it first (kindcache only treats it as dead scratch). Layout: STX zp is 2 bytes removed and 2 added, so .classify, .shown and all later labels keep their addresses (.shown 929E, .classified 92C9), loop stays inside page &92 so no branch crosses a page; no other reference to classify labels in src/ or the grind/dataflow configs. Not protected, not generated, no ROMSEL/ACCCON dependence (zero page, no bank change), no new RAM. Recount from the window profile: STX ren_i 101.9 cycles/pass = 34 executions of 3 cycles; shown_y runs 5.1/2 = 2.55 times a pass, so saving = 101.9 - 2.55*3 = 94.3 cycles/pass = 2.77 per execution of the loop.
